findings.claim: Checklist item paired_population is green with the title 'Every arm scored on identical events'.
findings.problem: Its own detail only establishes exposure ('every arm has seen all of them'), not identical scoring. The arena shows scored screen samples of 1560 for control and placebo, 1556 for tp-7pct, 1563 for hold-12h, 874 for vol-4x and 498 for entry-8pct. Arms whose scored populations differ by a factor of three are not scored on identical events, so the green title asserts more than the evidence behind it.

findings.claim: '4848 events in the shared window; every arm has seen all of them' plus per-arm 'declined=47'.
findings.problem: The denominators do not reconcile. Events by tier total backfill 4764 plus live 84, matching the 4848 figure, yet control reports screen_n=1560 with 14 still open and declined=47. Under either reading of declined — 47 events or 47 percent — the majority of the 4848 shared events appear in no arm's scored table and no accounting is given for them. Until that gap is explained, 'identical events' rests on an unverified denominator.

findings.claim: The open-trade audit ('81 trades still open; 0 of them leaked into a scored table') and the paired-population audit cover the arena.
findings.problem: The per-arm open-trade dictionary lists only control, hold-12h, placebo, sl-5pct, tp-7pct and vol-4x. entry-8pct is a running arm with live_n=5 and screen_n=498 and does not appear at all. Either it was excluded from the exclusion audit or its open count was never computed, so the 'zero leakage' guarantee is not demonstrated for every running arm.

findings.claim: Checklist item backfill_cannot_promote is green: 'Only live-tape evidence can promote'.
findings.problem: The supporting detail is '0 surfaced arm(s); none promoted from a screen'. With zero arms ever surfaced, the guard has never had an opportunity to fire, so the green mark records absence of opportunity rather than a demonstrated block. This matters because every arm currently carries a screen_dWR headline — hold-12h at 3.27pp on screen_n=1563 and sl-5pct at 5.26pp on screen_n=1560 — while live_n is 26 and 23 against a confirm planned n of 600.

findings.claim: Checklist item placebo_inert: 'Placebo is provably inert', discordant pairs b=0 c=0.
findings.problem: The evidence cited is control n=1560 WR=50.1 versus placebo n=1560 WR=50.1, which is screen/backfill data. Both arms also carry live_n=23, and no discordant-pair count is reported on the live tape. Inertness is claimed as proven at the tier that cannot promote, and left unmeasured at the tier that can.

findings.claim: 'MECHANISM CLASSES (one per running arm — diversity is enforced in code)'.
findings.problem: The running arms violate this as listed: control and entry-8pct are both class=entry_trigger, and placebo and vol-4x are both class=liquidity_filter. Either the one-per-class rule is not actually enforced over running arms, or control and placebo are exempt in code while still being labelled with a mechanism class in the arena table — in which case the class field for those two rows is metadata that does not describe what the arm does.
